description: Everything the console observes, plus the launcher that starts it. The observation hooks POST each event to the console on its default port through a curl one-liner that always exits 0, so a console that isn't running costs nothing but a discarded connection refusal instead of a hook-error notice on every tool call. A POST that finds nothing listening hands off to console-restart.sh, which brings a crashed console back on what it last watched and stays silent either way. The launcher exits immediately unless a real team exists, except on the Workflow tool — a workflow forms no team, so that matcher points the console at the session that ran it instead. SessionStart also runs console-hint.sh, which replaces a console running an older build than the session loaded and otherwise only nudges toward /team8:console. PreToolUse on TaskCreate and TaskUpdate also runs task-gate.sh, which gates a team8 task's metadata and a teammate's completion on the call's own input instead of observing anything. Timeouts are in seconds. The console's answer to a teammate's PostToolUse can carry added context: a reminder to report progress on a task that has sat unchanged for two minutes. A second PostToolUse hook, inbox-deliver.js, hands a teammate its unread messages as added context after each of its tool calls and marks them read, so the delivery at the end of its turn skips them; the lead's hooks carry no agent_id and never start it.

hooks.command: curl -sS -m 5 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:4823/hook 2>/dev/null || OCTO_PORT=4823 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/console-restart.sh"; exit 0
curl -sS -m 5 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:4823/hook 2>/dev/null || OCTO_PORT=4823 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/console-restart.sh"; exit 0
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/hooks/inbox-deliver.js" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
